label: Table 2
caption: Colony counts (CFU/mL) after fermentations at different temperatures (30 and 37 °C) and different levels of glucose addition for tiger nut, carob and rice beverages.
footnotes: All tests at different sugar levels were conducted at 37 °C. Level 1 *: no glucose added. Level 2 **: 7.5 g/100 mL of glucose for rice and tiger nut beverages and 15 g/100 mL for carob beverages. Level 3 ***: 15 g/100 mL of glucose for rice and tiger nut beverages and 30 g/100 mL for carob beverages. n.d.: Not determined.

label: Table 3
caption: Peak integration (×106) area values from the EICs of the phytochemical compounds identified by UHPLC-QTOF in non-fermented and fermented tiger nut beverages employing different LAB consortia (VEGE022, VEGE033, VEGE053 and VEGE061) for 24 h.
footnotes: * Phenolic compounds. EICs: Extracted Ion Chromatograms Metabolites. Metabolites highlighted in bold were quantified with external standards. n.d.: not detected. Different letters (a–c) in the same row indicate statistically significant differences (p value < 0.05) according to one-way ANOVA followed by LSD post-hoc test. Bold value indicates that phenolic-derived metabolites were quantified with an external standard (µM).

label: Table 4
caption: Peak integration (×106) area values from the EICs of the phytochemical compounds identified by UHPLC-QTOF in carob beverages non-fermented and fermented with different consortiums of LAB (VEGE022, VEGE033, VEGE053 and VEGE061) for 72 h.
footnotes: * Phenolic compounds. EICs: Extracted Ion Chromatograms Metabolites. Metabolites highlighted in bold were quantified with external standards. n.d.: not detected. Different letters (a–c) in the same row indicate statistically significant differences (p value < 0.05) according to one-way ANOVA followed by LSD post-hoc test. Bold value indicates that phenolic-derived metabolites were quantified with an external standard (µM).

label: Table 5
caption: Peak integration (×106) area values from the EICs of the phytochemical compounds identified by UHPLC-QTOF in rice beverages non-fermented or fermented with different consortiums of lactic acid bacteria (VEGE022, VEGE033, VEGE053 and VEGE061) for 24 h.
footnotes: * Phenolic compounds. EICs: Extracted Ion Chromatograms Metabolites. n.d.: not detected. Different letters (a–c) in the same row indicate statistically significant differences (p value < 0.05) according to one-way ANOVA followed by LSD post-hoc test.

label: Table 6
caption: Proximate composition expressed in g/100 g in the non-fermented (NF) and fermented with different LAB consortium tiger nut, carob and rice beverages. Saturated fat is calculated as % of total fatty acids.
footnotes: Different letters (a–c) in the same column and in the same sample indicate statistically significant differences (p value < 0.05) according to one-way ANOVA followed by LSD post-hoc test. n.d: Not detected.
